ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on the left and right lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a broad central wedge originating from the peduncle, extending to the median notch, and tracing along the trailing edges toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree angle at the vertex; depth is pronounced relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits 4-5 high-amplitude peaks (tooth-like protrusions), while the right lobe shows more frequent, lower-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips; convex trajectory along the leading outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (bright white spots) located near the center-right boundary of the dark pigment and the lower-left white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white fields of both lobes, primarily in vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/trauma site on the upper-distal edge of the left lobe; dense parallel linear scarring across the lateral white zones.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated high-intensity (pure white) circular punctate mark located within the central dark pigment zone.
